info.notes: Procedural, seeded (deterministic). Diffuse model Lambert on all lab materials to match Cycles Principled v2.

pbr_overview.purpose: whole lab, subpixel wires, tonemapping range

pbr_grazing.purpose: high-frequency texture at grazing angles, anisotropic filtering, moire

pbr_dark_room.purpose: dark indirect-only interior next to bright exterior

pbr_thin.purpose: comb of thin cylinders, fence, alpha foliage

pbr_specular.purpose: high-frequency normal map on glossy metal (specular aliasing)

moving_object.purpose: static camera, box sweeping across spheres: ghosting / disocclusion trails

camera_pan.purpose: 45 deg/s yaw pan over spheres, comb and fence: blur and history rejection under camera motion

foliage_strafe.purpose: lateral strafe past alpha-scissor grass and fence: alpha shimmer, disocclusion

specular_orbit.purpose: slow orbit around ridged glossy sphere: specular shimmer

thin_dolly.purpose: slow dolly toward the comb and the subpixel wires: thin-geometry stability
